name: nrf52840-promicro
description: V1940 ProMicro NRF52840, a nice!nano-compatible clone (1MB flash, 256KB SRAM), HSE 32MHz -> 64MHz. Ships the Adafruit nRF52 UF2 bootloader with SoftDevice S140 6.1.1, so the application runs at 0x26000 and is flashed as a UF2 via the bootloader mass-storage. No RGB LED (user LED on P0.15, the nice!nano blue). The on-chip USB is exposed by the app as a CherryUSB composite device: a CDC console (port 0) plus, built from Lisp, a HID keyboard (and optional extra CDC / mouse) — so it can enumerate as a USB keyboard. The console is also available on the physical UART (TX/RX on P1.02/P1.03 @115200). I2C1 SCL P0.27 / SDA P0.26. ESB radio is available for split-keyboard half-to-half; BLE HID uses the on-chip S140.
